MINUTES
  MALIBU CITY COUNCIL
7  SPECIAL MEETING
  OCTOBER 2, 2024
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  1:00 P.M.

  MEETING CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Stewart called the meeting to order at 1:01 pm.

  ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Mayor Doug Stewart; Mayor Pro Tem Marianne Riggins; and
  Councilmembers Paul Grisanti, Bruce Silverstein, and Steve Uhring.

  ALSO PRESENT: Trevor Rusin, Interim City Attorney; Steve McClary, City Manager;
  Joseph Toney, Assistant City Manager; Alexis Brown, Deputy City Manager; Kelsey
  Pettijohn, City Clerk; Kristin Riesgo, Community Services Director; Yolanda Bundy,
  Environmental Sustainability Director; Maureen Tamuri, Interim Flaming Director; Susan
  Duef1as, Public Safety Director; and Rob DuBouX, Public Works Director; Julie Bauer,
  Senior Permit Services Technician; Andre Ketchedjian, Senior Plan Check Engineer; Tyler
  Eaton, Senior Planner; and Patricia Salazar, Development and Operations Manager

  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Community Services Director Riesgo led the Pledge of Allegiance.

  REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA

  City Clerk Pettijohn reported that the agenda for the meeting was properly posted on
  September 27, 2024.

  APPROVAL OF AGENDA

  MOTION  Councilmember Silverstein moved, and Councilmember Grisanti seconded a
  motion to approve the agenda. The motion carried unanimously.

  ITEM 1  NEW BUSINESS

  A.  Proposed Schedule of Fees Fiscal Year 2024-25
  Recommended Action: Provide direction and feedback to staff on the Fiscal Year
  (FY) 2024-25 Proposed Budget.

  Flaming Department and Environmental Sustainability staff presented on fees for
  development proj ects and answered questions from the Councilmembers.

  The Council discussed the recommended fees and priorities for cost recovery. The
   Malibu City Council
  Minutes of October 2, 2024
  Page 2 of 2

  Council discussed ways to subsidize Flaming fees While maintaining a 75% cost
  recovery rate and options to incentivize smaller proj ects.

  CONSENSUS
  By consensus, the Council directed the Administration and Finance Subcommittee
  to review the fee schedule and make a recommendation regarding development fee
  subsidies.

  ADJOURNMENT

  Mayor Stewart adj ourned the meeting at 3:58 p.m.
